product.description: Cat6A 28AWG Slim UTP Ethernet Network Patch Cable, Snagless Boot, 6ft, BlackPower your network with 10-Gigabit speed using this 6 ft Black Cat6A 28AWG Slim UTP Ethernet® Network Patch Cable. Built with four twisted pairs of 28AWG stranded bare copper conductors in a slim outer jacket, this cable supports bandwidth up to 500MHz and delivers full 10GBASE-T performance across runs up to the Cat6A certified 100-meter distance — ideal for AV-over-IP, cloud workloads, multi-Gigabit Wi-Fi backhaul, and PoE++ powered devices like access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. The 28AWG slim profile is roughly 30% smaller in diameter than standard 24AWG patch cables, freeing space and improving airflow in high-density racks and patch panels. Each end is terminated with a precision-molded RJ45 plug featuring 50-micron gold-plated contacts that resist corrosion and preserve signal integrity over the life of the cable, while the snagless strain-relief boot shields the locking tab from breakage when you plug, unplug, or pull the cable through a tight wall plate. At 6 feet, this length comfortably reaches across a desk or between adjacent rack bays without forcing a tight bend. Wired to the T-568B standard and verified to ANSI/TIA-568.2-D Category 6A by both UL® and ETL, this black patch cable is a clean, professional-grade choice for high-density patch panels, server rooms,
